text: Entry 1303 accidentally returns false from the whole query when one folder fails the recency criterion. Entry 1304 changes that line to continue. The accepted date-filter loop also continues for unmatched folders. For this generator/filter loop, reject the current candidate without changing the API result type or skipping later candidates. This is a scoped control-flow rule and a verified source repair, not a reproduced runtime failure or an inferred reviewer concern. Both discussions remain pending and no extension test was run.
title: The recent-query copy-paste fix continues the folder loop instead of returning from the API
